summary: Kleinjan's is a family-run potato trading and packing company in Goudswaard, the Netherlands, dealing in seed, table, export and industrial potatoes and running its own sorting and packing operation. Jaap Kleinjan started the business in 1975. Its subsidiary Kleinjan's Teelt B.V. has organised its own seed potato production since 2001.
products: Seed potatoes grown under licence by selected seed growers
Open (free) seed varieties for local and export markets
Table potatoes, about 30 varieties incl. grill and baby potatoes
Export potatoes, including new potatoes for distant destinations
Industrial potatoes, including for peeling plants
Sorting and packing: 5 kg poly bags, 10 to 25 kg bags, big bags
markets: Supermarkets (new potatoes from June to August)
facts: 1991: warehouse of about 1,250 m² built in Goudswaard
2005: Goudswaard warehouse gained 700 m² of floor space and two dock shelters
2014: Aardenburg sorting site (opened 1999) closed; machines moved to Goudswaard
Second generation: Adrie Kleinjan took over the whole company in 2002

contact.address: Kleinjan's Aardappelhandel B.V., Zuidoordseweg 6, 3267 LW Goudswaard, the Netherlands

limitations: The website names no seed or table potato varieties, licensing breeders, export countries or agents.
Seed hectares, tonnages, generations, storage capacity, sorting throughput, turnover and staff numbers are not published on the pages read.
